candidates.title: U.S. lawmaker submits amendment naming India in Russia sanctions act
candidates.excerpt: The Lindsey O Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, passed by the U.S. Senate by an overwhelming 86-11 vote last month, seeks to impose sanctions not only on Russia's leadership and energy sector but also on the "shadow fleet" of vessels that enable Moscow to evade sanctions on oil deliveries.

candidates.title: US suspends 870,000 borrowers over suspected pandemic loan fraud
candidates.excerpt: US Vice President JD Vance said the Small Business Administration had suspended nearly 870,000 borrowers over suspected pandemic loan fraud involving an estimated $39 billion in taxpayer money, while officials pledged to pursue fraudulent borrowers and prevent future losses.

candidates.title: Police arrest BRS leaders over turmeric water protest near KCR’s residence
candidates.excerpt: Seven BRS leaders from Varadarajpur were arrested for allegedly spraying turmeric water on Congress leaders heading to K. Chandrashekhar Rao’s residence. A court remanded them to 15 days in judicial custody following a police investigation.
